questions.stem: 兩年來，老師們一直用 3D 印表機，為那些覺得科學概念抽象的學生做模型。
questions.answer: For two years, teachers have been using 3D printers to make models for those who find scientific concepts abstract.
accepted_answers: For the past two years, the teachers have been using a 3D printer to create models for students who find scientific concepts abstract.
Over the past two years, teachers have been using 3D printers to build models for those students who think scientific concepts are abstract.

questions.stem: 看到自己的設計變成模型，學生們對科學越來越有興趣。
questions.answer: Seeing their own designs turn into models, students are becoming more and more interested in science.
accepted_answers: Watching their own designs become models, the students have become more and more interested in science.
Seeing their designs turned into models, students are growing more and more interested in science.

1.explanation_zh: 「兩年來…一直用」是從兩年前持續到現在、而且還在進行，用現在完成進行式 have been using，時間寫 for two years（或 for the past two years、over the past two years），放句首或句尾都可以。「老師們」是複數，主詞 teachers 配 have been。「為那些…的學生做模型」中文把長修飾語放在名詞前面，英文改成 for those who …（those who＝…的人），who 子句說明是哪些人：those who find scientific concepts abstract（find + 受詞 + 形容詞＝覺得某事…）。「用 3D 印表機做模型」：use 3D printers to make models，不定詞表示用途。
evidence: 老師們一直用 3D 印表機
為那些覺得科學概念抽象的學生做模型
1.strategy_zh: 「…來一直…」想 have been + V-ing + for／since；「那些…的人」先想 those who …。
hints: 切成四段：兩年來／老師們一直用 3D 印表機／為那些覺得科學概念抽象的學生／做模型
標的詞彙：teacher（老師）、printer（印表機）、model（模型）、scientific（科學的）、concept（概念）、abstract（抽象的）
句型框架：For + 時間, S + have been + V-ing … to VR … for those who + V …

2.explanation_zh: 前半句「看到自己的設計變成模型」沒有主詞，動作者就是後面的「學生們」，英文改成分詞構句 Seeing their own designs turn into models,（see + 受詞 + 原形動詞＝看到…變成…）；主要子句一定要以 students 當主詞，否則會變成懸垂分詞。「越來越有興趣」用 more and more interested，描述正在發生的變化可用 are becoming／are growing；人感到興趣用 interested in。
evidence: 看到自己的設計變成模型
2.strategy_zh: 兩個動作共用一個主詞、中間沒有連接詞時，可以把前一個動作改成 V-ing 分詞構句；「越來越…」想 more and more + adj.（或比較級 and 比較級）。
hints: 切成四段：看到自己的設計／變成模型／學生們／對科學越來越有興趣
標的詞彙：see（看到）、design（設計）、model（模型）、student（學生）、interested（感興趣的）、science（科學）
句型框架：V-ing + O …, S + be becoming + more and more + adj. + in …

references: For two years, teachers have been using 3D printers to make models for those who find scientific concepts abstract.
For the past two years, the teachers have been using a 3D printer to create models for students who find scientific concepts abstract.
Over the past two years, teachers have been using 3D printers to build models for those students who think scientific concepts are abstract.

patterns.label_zh: 現在完成進行式（兩年來一直…）
patterns.frame: For + 時間, S + have been + V-ing …（for 片語也可以放句尾）

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「兩年來」是一段時間，用 for two years；since 後面接時間起點（since 2024）。
「兩年來」是從兩年前一直到現在，不是「兩年前」two years ago。

common_errors.explanation_zh: 現在完成進行式是 have been + V-ing，been 不能省略。
「兩年來一直」從過去持續到現在，用現在完成進行式 have been using。

common_errors.right: the teachers have been using 3D printers
common_errors.explanation_zh: 題目是「老師們」（複數），主詞用 teachers，動詞用 have been。

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「覺得某事很…」用 find + 受詞 + 形容詞，或 feel that + 子句；feel 不能直接接受詞補語。

common_errors.right: for those who find scientific concepts abstract

traps.literal_error: Teachers always use 3D printers two years to make models for those who find scientific concepts abstract.
traps.explanation_zh: 「兩年來一直」從過去持續到現在而且仍在進行，用現在完成進行式 have been using，並加 for two years（放句首或句尾都可以）。

traps.zh: 那些覺得科學概念抽象的學生
traps.literal_error: For two years, teachers have been using 3D printers to make models for those feel scientific concepts abstract students.
traps.explanation_zh: 「那些…的學生」的修飾語很長，英文要放到後面：those who find scientific concepts abstract。

1.restructuring_zh: 「那些覺得科學概念抽象的學生」是長的前置修飾，英文改成 those who find scientific concepts abstract（those who…＝…的人；「…的＋名詞」改後位修飾）。

references: Seeing their own designs turn into models, students are becoming more and more interested in science.
Watching their own designs become models, the students have become more and more interested in science.
Seeing their designs turned into models, students are growing more and more interested in science.

patterns.frame: V-ing …, S + V …（分詞的意義主詞＝主要子句主詞）
patterns.zh_trigger: 看到自己的設計變成模型

patterns.frame: S + be becoming + more and more + adj.

common_errors.explanation_zh: 兩個動作共用主詞 students，前半句改成分詞構句 Seeing …；用原形動詞開頭會變成祈使句。
學生們各有作品，design 用複數。
become 後面直接接名詞，不加 to；也可以用 turn into。

common_errors.wrong: science becomes more and more interesting to students
common_errors.right: students are becoming more and more interested in science
common_errors.explanation_zh: 分詞構句的主詞要和主要子句的主詞相同；看到設計的是學生，主要子句要以 students 開頭，否則會變成懸垂分詞。

common_errors.right: are becoming more and more interested in science

traps.zh: 看到自己的設計變成模型
traps.literal_error: See their own designs become models, students more and more interested in science.
traps.explanation_zh: 前半句沒有主詞，用原形動詞開頭會變成祈使句；英文要改成分詞構句 Seeing …，並讓主要子句的主詞是 students。

traps.literal_error: Seeing their own designs turn into models, students are becoming more and more interesting in science.
traps.explanation_zh: 人「感到有興趣」用 interested in；interesting 是「令人感興趣的」。

bonus.text: Seeing their own designs turn into models, students are becoming increasingly interested in science.
bonus.explanation_zh: increasingly + 形容詞也表示「越來越…」，語氣比較正式；本題練習的標的句型是 more and more interested。

2.restructuring_zh: 前半句沒有主詞、和後半句共用主詞「學生們」，英文改成分詞構句 Seeing their own designs turn into models, students …（分詞的意義主詞必須是 students）。

warnings: group.q1: 中文字數（只計漢字） 29，出題規格書建議 18–28

1.translation: For two years, the teachers have been using 3D printers to make models for students who find scientific concepts abstract.
1.explanation_zh: 「兩年來……一直」表示從過去持續到現在的動作，用現在完成進行式 have been using 加 for two years；「用……做模型」用不定詞 to make models 表目的；「那些覺得科學概念抽象的學生」用 who 引導的限定關係子句，find + 受詞 + 形容詞 abstract。

2.translation: Seeing their own designs turn into models, the students have become more and more interested in science.
2.explanation_zh: 前半句「看到自己的設計變成模型」和主句同主詞，用分詞構句 Seeing…；see + 受詞 + 原形動詞 turn into；「越來越有興趣」用比較級重複 more and more interested in；時態可用現在完成式或現在進行式（are becoming），中文沒有明確時間標記，所以信心給 medium。

issues_zh: （小建議，不影響判定）REL 標的句型的 label_zh／frame 寫的是 for those who …，但參考譯文 2 和我的盲譯都用 for students who …（一般限定關係子句）；建議 label 改成「限定關係子句（those／students who …）」，免得和參考譯文 2 看起來不一致。

1.translation: For two years, teachers have been using 3D printers to make models for students who find scientific concepts abstract.
1.explanation_zh: 「兩年來……一直」是從過去持續到現在的動作，用現在完成進行式 have been using，並搭配 for two years。「為了……做模型」用不定詞 to make models for ...；「那些覺得科學概念抽象的學生」用關係子句 students who find scientific concepts abstract（find + O + adj）。

2.translation: Seeing their own designs turn into models, the students are becoming more and more interested in science.
2.explanation_zh: 「看到自己的設計變成模型」用分詞構句 Seeing ...，主詞和主要子句相同（學生），感官動詞 see + 受詞 + 原形動詞 turn into；「越來越有興趣」用 more and more interested，配合 are becoming 表示正在進行的變化。
